capabilities: Define custom shell commands in the settings
Run commands via the command palette or hotkeys
Insert note variables like file path and date/time into commands
Direct command output into the active note
Set a working directory for command execution
extras: Desktop only, no mobile support due to NodeJS child_process. README carries strong security warnings about running untrusted commands and notes Windows/PowerShell character corruption issues. Extensive documentation and usage examples are hosted externally, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian cannot run external system commands or launch outside applications, so users have to leave the app or script things manually.

relations.evidence: You can use this to open other vaults, switch workspaces without using a graphical user interface, and append content to notes
You can create macros that launch multiple commands at once.
you might benefit more from Text Expander

summary: Shell command runner that lets you define terminal commands and execute them from Obsidian via the command palette, hotkeys, or automation, with note variables and output capture.
